# Md Abu Sayed, Ph.D.
> Postdoctoral Research Scholar at the Center for Digital Cardiovascular Innovations (CDCI), University of Miami Miller School of Medicine. Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering from University of Nevada, Reno (May 2026). Applied AI Scientist and Engineer specializing in Medical Image Analysis, Medical AI Systems, and Applied AI for Autonomous Systems.

## Primary Job Profiles & Specializations

### 1. Specialist in Medical Image Analysis & Medical AI Systems
- **Current Role**: Postdoctoral Research Scholar, Center for Digital Cardiovascular Innovations (CDCI), University of Miami Miller School of Medicine / UHealth System (PI: Dr. Yiannis S. Chatzizisis, Chief of Cardiovascular Medicine).
- **Core Focus**: Multimodal intracoronary image analysis fusing 60 MHz High-Definition Intravascular Ultrasound (HD-IVUS), Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), and X-ray Angiography for coronary lesion phenotyping and agentic Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS).
- **Technical Capabilities**: Multi-class deep learning segmentation (Lumen, EEM, fibrous plaque, calcified arc with acoustic shadowing), automated stent sizing, finite element analysis (FEA) expansion simulation, under-expansion risk prediction, and lesion preparation guidance (e.g., Intravascular Lithotripsy [IVL] vs. rotational atherectomy).
- **Foundational Work**: Retinal vessel segmentation using Local Haar Patterns (DRIVE, STARE, CHASE_DB1); graph convolutional networks (GCNs) and Mask-RCNN for bilateral/ipsilateral mammogram fusion in breast cancer detection.

### 2. Applied AI Scientist for Autonomous Systems
- **Doctoral Research**: Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, University of Nevada, Reno (Defended May 2026). Advising: Prof. Monica Nicolescu and Prof. Mircea Nicolescu.
- **Core Focus**: Multi-agent intent recognition, future-intent forecasting, and intent-conditioned trajectory prediction in safety-critical autonomous maritime environments.
- **Key Contributions**:
  - **NavySim Multi-Vessel Simulation Engine**: High-fidelity Unity simulation engine with custom shaders, real-time CPA/TCPA threat heatmaps, and streaming TCP integration for machine learning models (*IEEE Transactions on Games* 2026, *IEEE CoG* 2024).
  - **Explainable Feature Attribution (CPFI & TFIS)**: Permutation feature importance and temporal feature importance scoring isolating bearing-rate, CPA/TCPA, and heading dynamics for early behavior recognition (*IEEE FMLDS* 2025).
  - **MTITP-WGAN**: Multi-task generative adversarial network jointly performing past-intent classification, future-intent forecasting, and multi-modal trajectory synthesis under heavy sensor noise (Chapter 7, Ph.D. Dissertation).
  - **Autonomous Robotics**: Role-shifting and embodied perspective-taking on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot for human–robot collaboration.

### 3. Applied AI Scientist and Engineer
- **Methodology**: Deep learning for prediction, sequence modeling, and decision support under noisy, incomplete, and high-stakes observations.
- **Engineering Stack**: Python, PyTorch, C#, Unity, OpenCV, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, CUDA, Git, Docker, MATLAB, C++, SQL.
- **Systems & Engineering**: Experience building machine learning pipelines, simulation-in-the-loop validation, explainable AI methods, and clinical decision support systems.
